episode_summary: In this episode, Danny Brown shares his insights on building a successful luxury real estate practice by focusing on long-term relationships and ethical practices. He discusses the importance of agent relationships and managing complex transactions with ultra high net worth clients. Danny also reflects on his transition from the music industry to real estate and the lessons learned along the way.
